content: Firestore quotas/pricing (official docs, fetched 2026-08-06): Spark free tier per DAY, reset ~midnight Pacific: 50,000 document reads, 20,000 writes, 20,000 deletes, 1 GiB stored; 'exactly one free database per project' (additional named databases require billing — affects setup if someone creates a second DB). Billing: reads = documents returned by queries + index-entry reads (queries with <=1 range field skip index charges); each onSnapshot initial result doc counts as a read; listeners with persistence don't re-read on reconnect. Quota exceeded -> API errors (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 429-style) — reads start failing until reset. This app (~10 writes/day, ~100 reads/day) sits 3 orders of magnitude under quota — but listener fan-out across tabs and monthly export queries still count; the daily-read math should be checked when adding new listeners, not assumed. No Cloud Functions on Spark (outbound network requires Blaze) — the default-account seed must stay console/Admin-SDK-side.
